name: Application Health Dashboard
description: Custom application health scores and SLA monitoring

nrql.query:
SELECT average(applicationHealthScore) FROM ApplicationHealthScore WHERE healthCategory = 
\overall' SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT average(customSlaCompliance) FROM CustomSlaCompliance SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT average(customErrorBudget) FROM CustomErrorBudget SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT average(customPerformanceScores) FROM CustomPerformanceScores WHERE scoreType = \performance' SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT average(applicationHealthScore) FROM ApplicationHealthScore FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(applicationHealthScore) FROM ApplicationHealthScore FACET healthCategory SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(applicationHealthScore) FROM ApplicationHealthScore FACET appName, healthCategory TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT average(customSlaCompliance) FROM CustomSlaCompliance FACET service SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(customErrorBudget) FROM CustomErrorBudget FACET service SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT component, average(customPerformanceScores), min(customPerformanceScores), max(customPerformanceScores) FROM CustomPerformanceScores WHERE scoreType = \performance' FACET component SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY average(customPerformanceScores) DESC
SELECT histogram(applicationHealthScore, 10, 100) FROM ApplicationHealthScore FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT slaName, service, customSlaCompliance, timePeriod FROM CustomSlaCompliance WHERE customSlaCompliance < 95 SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY customSlaCompliance ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT appName, healthCategory, applicationHealthScore, timestamp FROM ApplicationHealthScore WHERE applicationHealthScore < 70 SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY applicationHealthScore ASC LIMIT 10
